primary_endpoint: Number of participants with a 30% reduction in ALT at 12 months.
efficacy_outcome: 19 participants receiving pentoxifylline versus 7 receiving placebo had a 30% ALT reduction; p=0.46 (ANOVA).
safety_signal: No serious adverse events in either group (pentoxifylline 0/19; placebo 0/7); deaths not reported.
